## SearchInput.svelte

### `interface Props`

- `value` :: The query. Bindable; works controlled and uncontrolled.
- `onValueChange` :: Called with the new text whenever it changes, including when it is cleared.
- `onSearch` :: Called with the current query after typing settles (250ms), and immediately when Enter is pressed.
- `size` :: The control height. Text follows this unless `textSize` is set. @default 'lg'
- `textSize` :: The text scale, independent of the control height. Follows `size` when omitted.
- `textColor` :: The ink of the loading spinner; muted by default so it stays an affordance rather than content.
- `shape` :: The corner shape. @default 'modern'
- `variant` :: `outline` is a bordered field, `secondary` a tinted one without a border, `ghost` is bare until hovered or focused. @default 'outline'
- `invalid` :: Marks the field invalid (red border, `aria-invalid`). Inside a `Field` it follows the field's error unless set.
- `loading` :: Shows a spinning indicator at the end of the field — for a search that is in flight.
- `shortcut` :: A keyboard hint shown while the field is empty, and a shortcut that focuses the field when that key is pressed.
- `ref` :: The underlying `<input>` element. Bindable.
- `disabled` :: Blocks pointer and keyboard input, and dims the frame.
